benefits.text: hince Single Eyeshadow Chill Voyage Edition is a limited-edition single eyeshadow from the 2026 Summer Collection, with 3 dual/multi-use shades inspired by cool summer air and silvery light on ocean waves. It helps complete an eye look, from a clear blue-silver accent to soft smoky depth, with just one pan. The soft, smooth cashmere powder adheres evenly, blends easily and melts into the skin, suitable for the eyes, highlights, cheeks or adding depth depending on the shade.

howToUse.text: Pick up an adequate amount with a finger or brush, apply to the eyelid and blend lightly. You can use the light shade on the inner corner, under-eye area, brow bone or bridge of the nose to catch the light; use the deep shade on the outer corner, along the lash line or in the crease to add depth. Layer more for a more defined summer smoky effect.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.
